description: Recorded secondary-market fills for one listing over the last 90 days, newest first, with quantity, price, settlement currency, USD value and a block-explorer link. Includes a summary (fill count, USD volume, volume-weighted price). The full history back to 2022 is available as a data license at bricktable.co/data.

days.description: Look-back window, up to 90 days on the free server. Default 90.

limit.description: Max fills returned (newest first). Default 50. The summary covers the whole window.

property_id.description: BrickTable property id from search_properties, e.g. 'realt-...' or 'lofty-...'.

name: get_property_trades
title: Executed trades for one property
